article.title: We all came here from somewhere: The Thirty-Seventh Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: Capitalism depends on precarious migrant labour to discipline workers, deepen division, and extract wealth while weaponising anti-immigrant rhetoric to obscure the neoliberal destruction of public services and social welfare. The post We all came here from somewhere: The Thirty-Seventh Newsletter (2026) appeared first on MR Online .
